breaking_news.headline: Kalshi and Polymarket crack down on paid influencers claiming election fraud
breaking_news.summary: Influencers are using prediction market odds to sow doubt in vote counting, in some cases in posts paid for by the companies themselves.

breaking_news.headline: Former '60 Minutes' correspondent Scott Pelley speaks out after firing
breaking_news.summary: Former 60 Minutes correspondent Scott Pelley said CBS news leader Bari Weiss shouldn't be leading the network. Pelley spoke to The New York Times just days after being fired by CBS.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's new chief content officer: 'I've been training for this job my whole life'
breaking_news.summary: Less than two weeks after overhauling its newsroom, NPR has hired Nadine Zylstra to be its chief content officer. She has been a top executive at Sesame Workshop, YouTube and Pinterest.

breaking_news.headline: With just days left, the U.S. opening match at the World Cup is still not sold out
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of tickets are still available for the U.S. and Canada opening matches for the World Cup on Friday. Even more are available in resale platforms — many at below face value.

breaking_news.headline: Hey, Siri: Apple just announced a long-awaited AI update
breaking_news.summary: At its annual developers' conference, Apple put the spotlight on new AI features, while highlighting security and child safety — and critiquing the company's AI competitors.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security funds could run short by 2032, program's Trustees warn
breaking_news.summary: A trust fund that helps to finance Social Security benefits is expected to run out of money in less than seven years — unless Congress acts to patch the system before that.

breaking_news.headline: House approves bill to speed up union contract negotiations
breaking_news.summary: The House has approved a bill to slash the time it takes for newly unionized workers to get a first contract. The measure allows for government intervention if a deal is not reached within 90 days.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation tops 4% for the first time in 3 years on spike in gasoline prices
breaking_news.summary: Inflation has surged to its highest level in more than three years since the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, triggering a surge in gasoline prices.

breaking_news.headline: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes in Afghanistan, reigniting tensions
breaking_news.summary: The fresh strikes come after weeks of relative calm in the restive border region between the two countries.

breaking_news.headline: Manhunt under way in South Africa after 12 killed in mass shooting in Johannesburg
breaking_news.summary: Another nine people were injured at an informal settlement in Cleveland late on Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: Inside Myanmar, rebels are losing ground as military forces men into army
breaking_news.summary: The BBC travels with rebels to frontline positions in Myanmar to see how the war is unfolding.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine says missiles hit military plant deep inside Russia
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's military also says it has struck a Russian oil refinery and a "shadow fleet" oil tanker in the Black Sea.

breaking_news.headline: World Cup referee denied US entry arrives home to hero's welcome in Somalia
breaking_news.summary: Omar Artan vows to officiate at the 2030 tournament instead, following his ban from entering the US.

breaking_news.headline: Norway crown princess's son to stay in custody before rape verdict, says court
breaking_news.summary: Thr ruling overturns a lower court's decision on Monday ordering the release of the crown princess's 29-year-old son.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 17, reports say
breaking_news.summary: Nine of them were killed in a series of attacks in the town of Tayr Debba, according to Lebanon's state news agency.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says US will hit Iran 'hard' again on Wednesday
breaking_news.summary: The US president warns Iran "will have to pay the price" for taking too long to agree a deal, after Tehran vows retaliation to any attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi to make some users reveal job details to tackle insider trading
breaking_news.summary: After issues with insider trading, the prediction betting platform is adding new rules.

breaking_news.headline: Beauty Pie LED mask ad banned over misleading anti-wrinkle claim
breaking_news.summary: The mask is not "clinically proven to reduce wrinkles in four weeks", the advertising watchdog finds.

breaking_news.headline: UK pint prices up 36% since last World Cup – here's why
breaking_news.summary: UK pint prices are up 36% since the last World Cup. We look at why beer now costs so much more.

breaking_news.headline: How to enjoy the World Cup - and keep your boss on side
breaking_news.summary: Football fans and bosses share their strategies to balance late night kick offs with work the next day.
